convert_chemistry_to_proto: convert a Chemistry object to a protobuf message for serialization
convert_proto_to_chemistry: convert a Chemistry protobuf message back to a Chemistry object
write_chemistries_and_items: write a sequence of chemistry and episode items tuples to a file as serialized protobuf
load_chemistries_and_items: load chemistry and episode items from a serialized protobuf file
convert_trial_items_to_proto: convert TrialItems containing stones and potions to a protobuf message
